title: Yields on Finnish benchmark government bonds
description:
Statistics on the yields on Finnish government benchmark bonds, issued by the Bank of Finland, calculated from LSEG's data on primary dealers' daily average selling prices of debt instruments as of 13.00 hours.  The tables show the benchmark bonds interest rate for a given maturity period for those bonds in the benchmark system. The benchmark bond system was established in 1992 and the rates are available since then. The tables are updated about 3:50 PM (GMT+2). Due to technical issue, data is missing for September 2, 2025.

Yields on Finnish benchmark government bonds are published for the information of the public and different institutions but not as a basis for trade.
